/-- [artifactkeeper_kernel::middleware::admin_middleware]:
    Source: 'src/middleware.rs', lines 176:0-213:1
    Visibility: public -/
def middleware.admin_middleware
  (db : tables.Db) (oracle : trusted.Oracle) (req : http.Request) :
  Result ((alloc.vec.Vec resolve.Write) × middleware.Outcome)
  := do
  let o ← middleware.csrf_guard req
  match o with
  | none =>
    let extracted ← http.extract_token req
    match extracted with
    | http.ExtractedToken.Bearer _ =>
      let ao ← resolve.try_resolve_auth_outcome oracle extracted false
      match ao with
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Resolved ext =>
        if ext.is_admin
        then
          let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.path
          let b ← paths.path_exempt_from_password_change s
          if b
          then
            ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next (some
              ext) false)
          else
            let b1 ← resolve.principal_must_change_password db ext.user_id
            if b1
            then
              middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
                middleware.Response.MustChangePassword
            else
              ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next
                (some ext) false)
        else
          let v ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 req.path
          let writes ←
            alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
              (resolve.Write.AuditPermissionDenied ext.user_id v req.method)
          middleware.respond writes middleware.Response.AdminRequired
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.NoCredential =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.InvalidOrExpiredToken)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.InvalidCredential =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.InvalidOrExpiredToken)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Overloaded =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          middleware.Response.ServiceUnavailable
    | http.ExtractedToken.ApiKey _ =>
      let ao ← resolve.try_resolve_auth_outcome oracle extracted false
      match ao with
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Resolved ext =>
        if ext.is_admin
        then
          let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.path
          let b ← paths.path_exempt_from_password_change s
          if b
          then
            ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next (some
              ext) false)
          else
            let b1 ← resolve.principal_must_change_password db ext.user_id
            if b1
            then
              middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
                middleware.Response.MustChangePassword
            else
              ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next
                (some ext) false)
        else
          let v ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 req.path
          let writes ←
            alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
              (resolve.Write.AuditPermissionDenied ext.user_id v req.method)
          middleware.respond writes middleware.Response.AdminRequired
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.NoCredential =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401
          middleware.Deny.InvalidOrExpiredApiToken)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.InvalidCredential =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401
          middleware.Deny.InvalidOrExpiredApiToken)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Overloaded =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          middleware.Response.ServiceUnavailable
    | http.ExtractedToken.Basic encoded =>
      let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref encoded
      let o1 ← resolve.decode_basic_credentials oracle s
      let b := core.option.Option.is_none o1
      if b
      then
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.InvalidBasic)
      else
        let ao ← resolve.try_resolve_auth_outcome oracle extracted false
        match ao with
        | resolve.AuthOutcome.Resolved ext =>
          if ext.is_admin
          then
            let s1 := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.path
            let b1 ← paths.path_exempt_from_password_change s1
            if b1
            then
              ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next
                (some ext) false)
            else
              let b2 ← resolve.principal_must_change_password db ext.user_id
              if b2
              then
                middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
                  middleware.Response.MustChangePassword
              else
                ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next
                  (some ext) false)
          else
            let v ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 req.path
            let writes ←
              alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
                (resolve.Write.AuditPermissionDenied ext.user_id v req.method)
            middleware.respond writes middleware.Response.AdminRequired
        | resolve.AuthOutcome.NoCredential =>
          middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
            (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.InvalidCredentials)
        | resolve.AuthOutcome.InvalidCredential =>
          middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
            (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.InvalidCredentials)
        | resolve.AuthOutcome.Overloaded =>
          middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
            middleware.Response.ServiceUnavailable
    | http.ExtractedToken.None =>
      let ao ←
        resolve.try_resolve_auth_outcome oracle http.ExtractedToken.None false
      match ao with
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Resolved ext =>
        if ext.is_admin
        then
          let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.path
          let b ← paths.path_exempt_from_password_change s
          if b
          then
            ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next (some
              ext) false)
          else
            let b1 ← resolve.principal_must_change_password db ext.user_id
            if b1
            then
              middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
                middleware.Response.MustChangePassword
            else
              ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next
                (some ext) false)
        else
          let v ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 req.path
          let writes ←
            alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
              (resolve.Write.AuditPermissionDenied ext.user_id v req.method)
          middleware.respond writes middleware.Response.AdminRequired
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.NoCredential =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.MissingHeader)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.InvalidCredential =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.MissingHeader)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Overloaded =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          middleware.Response.ServiceUnavailable
    | http.ExtractedToken.Invalid =>
      let ao ←
        resolve.try_resolve_auth_outcome oracle http.ExtractedToken.Invalid
          false
      match ao with
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Resolved ext =>
        if ext.is_admin
        then
          let s := alloc.vec.Vec.deref req.path
          let b ← paths.path_exempt_from_password_change s
          if b
          then
            ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next (some
              ext) false)
          else
            let b1 ← resolve.principal_must_change_password db ext.user_id
            if b1
            then
              middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
                middleware.Response.MustChangePassword
            else
              ok (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write, middleware.Outcome.Next
                (some ext) false)
        else
          let v ← alloc.vec.CloneVec.clone core.clone.CloneU8 req.path
          let writes ←
            alloc.vec.Vec.push (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
              (resolve.Write.AuditPermissionDenied ext.user_id v req.method)
          middleware.respond writes middleware.Response.AdminRequired
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.NoCredential =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.InvalidHeaderFormat)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.InvalidCredential =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          (middleware.Response.Plain401 middleware.Deny.InvalidHeaderFormat)
      | resolve.AuthOutcome.Overloaded =>
        middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write)
          middleware.Response.ServiceUnavailable
  | some refusal =>
    middleware.respond (alloc.vec.Vec.new resolve.Write) refusal

import Spec
import I5hLib
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result artifactkeeper_kernel artifactkeeper_kernel.Spec I5hLib

namespace artifactkeeper_kernel.Solution

lemma csrf_guard_not_admin_required (req : http.Request)
    (h : middleware.csrf_guard req = ok (some middleware.Response.AdminRequired)) : False := by
  unfold middleware.csrf_guard at h
  simp only [I5hLib.bind_tc_eq_ok] at h
  rcases h with ⟨b, _, hb⟩
  split at hb <;> simp at hb

lemma push_new_val {α : Type} (x : α) (w : alloc.vec.Vec α)
    (h : (alloc.vec.Vec.new α).push x = ok w) :
    w.val = [x] := by
  have hlen : (alloc.vec.Vec.new α).val.length < Usize.max := by
    simp; scalar_tac
  have hspec := alloc.vec.Vec.push_spec (alloc.vec.Vec.new α) x hlen
  have hp := post_of_ok hspec h
  simp at hp
  exact hp

theorem admin_denial_audited (db : tables.Db) (o : trusted.Oracle) (req : http.Request)
    (ws : alloc.vec.Vec resolve.Write)
    (h : middleware.admin_middleware db o req = ok (ws, .Respond .AdminRequired)) :
    ∃ u, ws.val = [resolve.Write.AuditPermissionDenied u req.path req.method] := by
  unfold middleware.admin_middleware middleware.respond at h
  i5h_invert h
  · simp only [u8vec_clone, ok.injEq] at *
    subst_vars
    have hw := push_new_val _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, hw⟩
  · simp only [u8vec_clone, ok.injEq] at *
    subst_vars
    have hw := push_new_val _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, hw⟩
  · simp only [u8vec_clone, ok.injEq] at *
    subst_vars
    have hw := push_new_val _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, hw⟩
  · simp only [u8vec_clone, ok.injEq] at *
    subst_vars
    have hw := push_new_val _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, hw⟩
  · simp only [u8vec_clone, ok.injEq] at *
    subst_vars
    have hw := push_new_val _ _ (by assumption)
    exact ⟨_, hw⟩
  · cases csrf_guard_not_admin_required req (by assumption)

end artifactkeeper_kernel.Solution
